title: Two-Ball Partner Passing
description: Partners pass two balls simultaneously back and forth, forcing both hands and eyes to track two objects in flight at once.

content.objective: Track and pass two balls at the same time without either one being dropped.
content.setup: Partners stand four metres apart, each starting with one ball.
instructions: Both partners pass their ball to the other at the same moment.
Catch and immediately pass back without pausing to reset.
Keep a steady rhythm for 30 seconds, then rest and repeat.
Mix pass types: one chest pass and one bounce pass happening at once.
coachingPoints: Keep both passes at a predictable, repeatable height.
Communicate out loud if the rhythm breaks down.
commonMistakes: Watching only one ball and losing track of the other.
Rushing the rhythm until passes collide.
Catching flat-footed instead of stepping to meet the ball.
content.safety: Keep pairs well spread so a dropped ball doesn't roll into another group.
